column1: Wait, "soudainement" is fine. But check: no time word? "soudainement" is not a time indicator really, it's manner. Fine. Also "si" with futur is grammatically wrong in French (si + présent). Better: "Inès criera fort quand le volcan entrera en éruption." "quand" is conjunction, fine. Word count: Inès, criera, fort, quand, le, volcan, entrera, en, éruption = 9 words. Good.
